reviews.title: Great Case, Bad Instructions
reviews.comment: Overall, I was very pleased with my purchase of the MUSETEX ATX PC case. The build quality is solid, and the value you get with 7 pre-installed PWM ARGB fans is excellent. Right out of the box, the fans were properly aligned for optimal heat dissipation, making airflow setup stress-free and effective. Cooling performance has been great, and the system stays cool even under load. The case looks fantastic, with a clean and modern design highlighted by the tempered glass panel. Once assembled, everything feels sturdy and well thought out from a performance and layout standpoint. The built-in dust filters are another strong point. The bottom filters are solid pieces held securely in rivet-like channels, while the top dust cover is magnetic, easy to remove, and holds firmly in place. The USB 3.0 ports are controlled by a single plug and perform at expected speeds without issue. The pre-installed power, reset, and HDD LED connectors were a nice touch and saved time during setup. I also appreciated the pre-installed Velcro-style cable ties, combined with multiple rear access points, which made cable management much easier and cleaner. The only real downside is the documentation. The instruction pamphlet was printed on very thin paper that tore easily, with small text that was difficult to read. Accessing the documentation while working inside the case was inconvenient, and the tempered glass panel removal was confusing at first. Since the glass appears to be magnetically held, clearer instructions—such as external diagrams or simple directional stickers—would greatly improve the user experience. Pros: Excellent cooling with 7 pre-installed PWM ARGB fans Fans correctly oriented for efficient heat dissipation Secure dust filters and thoughtful design features Clean aesthetics and solid build quality Great overall value Cons: Poor instruction quality (thin paper, small text) Documentation difficult to reference during installation Glass panel removal needs clearer guidance Despite the documentation issues, this is still a great case with strong performance, cooling, and aesthetics. If MUSETEX improves the instructions and paper quality, this would easily be a near-perfect product. Note: The included video I submitted does not show the side tempered glass installed or final cable management.
reviews.author: Wendell Keoughan

reviews.title: Cheap but NOT!
reviews.comment: This is a very nice case! i love building computers and the ease of moving my old pc over to this new case was amazing! there is so much space and i love all the glass and the amount of fans you could have in here! its very light compared to most full towers and the style of it is very modern! i am very happy with this case!
reviews.author: Shuujuu

reviews.title: Perfect case! Buy if you need good quality!
reviews.comment: I dont usually write reviews, but this case deserves one. 10-10  I recently upgraded my old stgaubron pc, all i was using was the case. That became an issue with the wires being everywhere, and i needed a bigger case. this one was PERFECT. Came with the fans complete and put together nicely, Installation was really easy, It doesn't overheat anymore as well. My old case was too small for my big ahh heat sink and this one gives it a bit more room for air to circulate around it. overall, strong build, easy to navigate and install stuff in, and really nice in general. def. recommend to anyone buying or upgrading their case.
reviews.author: Trace

reviews.title: Awesome Beginner Case For A Great Price $$$
reviews.comment: Although I’m ashamed to admit it took me quite long to assemble everything, I will say that this case and the six included RGB fans are amazing and work great. They run quiet and everything inside the PC is nice and cool. The tempered glass is very durable and looks so good once you peel the satisfying plastic layer off (don’t leave fingerprints!!!). The included screws and manual help with installing and wiring the fans, and the wiring is mostly neat and already tucked away for you, all you have to do is hook it up to your motherboard! I could be biased because I got this case for $38 after using a coupon and a gift card but still for its base price I would hands down buy this again for my next build if I were to switch cases.. but I will probably stick with this one for quite some time because it looks so good. P.S. For those who are new like me and are concerned about compatibility, this case and a few of the other cases from MUSETEX are available to select on pcpartpicker.com and will make the build process so much easier!
reviews.author: Dax Helmert

reviews.title: Good case but buy new fans the RGB lights go out on them pretty quick
reviews.comment: I bought this case for my First ever pc Build, I bought it because the Case i wanted would not fit the power supply i wanted at the time. so i returned it and bought this one, I like it i do not love it, 2 weeks ago the RGB lights on the fans burned out, so now I'm Staring into a black void i only see the RGB on my ram still working, so i would advise getting better fans from the start and trashing these, it is easy to remove the panels to get to the back where the Power supply and the cables are, The cooling is nice 6 fans but i have to replace them because my RGB lights went out. to quote Todd Howard here It just works, if you want a functional case then this is a good one Decent price, But it makes me want to change it
